pkg/agent/agent.go: 1

`160-160`: ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Poor tradeoff** **Do not report max-time when a finished source is still delivering its last URL.** When a source has closed its channel, its final URL can still wait for the forwarding loop to send it. The forwarding loop blocks on `results <- resp` until the caller reads the URL, and `wg.Wait()` does not return until that send completes. If `maxEnumTime` expires during this delay, the check at line 160 emits `ErrMaxTimeReached` for a result set that is complete. Track source completion separately from result delivery. Emit the notice only when a source is still running when the deadline expires. Add a test that delays consumption past the deadline after a source has closed its channel, and assert that no notice is emitted.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "fix: warn when max-time cuts enumeration short" matches the main change. The PR adds an ErrMaxTimeReached error that is emitted when the -max-time limit ends enumeration with partial results, and the CLI logs it at info level. The title is specific, concise, and does not use vague terms.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changes support the notice requirement of `#165`. pkg/agent/agent.go adds the exported ErrMaxTimeReached and its emission rule. internal/runner/enumerate.go adds logResultError to log that notice at info and keep other source errors as warnings. The tests in pkg/agent/agent_test.go and internal/runner/enumerate_test.go verify this behavior. No change in the summary alters the default timeout, unrelated sources, or other CLI behavior. The summary does not show any unrelated change.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#165` has two expected behaviors: (1) large domains finish under the defaults, and (2) a run cut off by -max-time says so. The PR implements (2). The reviewed summary shows ErrMaxTimeReached in pkg/agent/agent.go, emitted only when the derived context hits a deadline and the caller context is still active. internal/runner/enumerate.go logs that error at info through logResultError. Tests in pkg/agent/agent_test.go and internal/runner/enumerate_test.go cover the notice, the non-reporting cases (normal completion, parent cancel, parent deadline), and log level. The PR does not implement (1). The PR description states that the 10-minute default is unchanged. The issue reports that a full Wayback pass for hackerone.com takes about 9 minutes and can exceed the default, so the default-run completion requirement remains unmet. No code in the reviewed summary changes the default or the Wayback run time. **Resolution** Address the default-completion requirement of `#165` in code, or get a maintainer decision that narrows `#165` to the notice requirement only. If the requirement stays, change the -max-time default or the enumeration path so that the large-domain run completes within the default limit, and add a test or measurement that shows it. If maintainers narrow the issue, update `#165` so its expected behavior matches the notice-only scope. Then re-review.
